stories.headline: OpenAI's Top Priority for AI Agents Is Automating AI Research
stories.blurb: OpenAI researcher Noam Brown revealed that the company's primary focus for next-generation agents is self-improving automation of AI research tasks.

stories.headline: OpenAI Acquires Smartphone Camera Maker Glass Imaging for $300M
stories.blurb: In a bid to enhance its visual AI capabilities, OpenAI has acquired Glass Imaging, a startup specializing in using AI to bring professional camera quality to smartphones.

stories.headline: Leaked iOS Build Reveals Siri's Deep Integration with Claude and ChatGPT
stories.blurb: Apple's upcoming Siri update will allow direct, deep integration with external AI models from both OpenAI and Anthropic to handle complex queries.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 Delivers 67x Better Performance per Dollar
stories.blurb: SemiAnalysis details how Nvidia's upcoming Vera Rubin architecture drastically slashes the cost of running agentic AI workflows.

stories.headline: Tech Giants Agree on New AEF-1 AI Evaluation Standard
stories.blurb: Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI have co-signed the emerging AEF-1 standard, paving the way for unified third-party evaluation of AI capabilities.

stories.headline: Google Officially Opens the Door to Anthropic's Claude for Its Engineers
stories.blurb: Google is allowing its internal developers to utilize Anthropic's Claude, marking a major shift in how the tech giant approaches competitive AI tools.

stories.headline: How Anthropic Scaled Test Impact Analysis for Agentic Coding
stories.blurb: To combat CI/CD bottlenecks caused by high-volume AI code generation, Anthropic has optimized its testing pipeline using smart dependency graphs.

stories.headline: Temporal Raises $550M to Power AI Backend Infrastructure
stories.blurb: The workflow orchestration platform Temporal has secured massive new funding at a $12.55B valuation to scale support for complex agentic AI applications.

stories.headline: Superhuman Acquires AI Notetaker Fathom
stories.blurb: Email client Superhuman is integrating AI meeting transcription directly into its workflow suite by acquiring popular virtual meeting assistant Fathom.

stories.headline: Einride and Lidl Launch First Cab-Less Autonomous Truck on Public German Roads
stories.blurb: Germany's roads are hosting their first fully driverless freight operations with a custom, cab-less vehicle carrying real cargo for Lidl.

stories.headline: Waymo Expands Robotaxi Service to Tokyo with Local Partners
stories.blurb: Waymo plans to bring its autonomous driving technology to Tokyo in 2027 by partnering with major Japanese taxi operators Nihon Kotsu and GO.

stories.headline: New York District Attorney Seizes 12 Celebrity Deepfake Websites
stories.blurb: Law enforcement in NY successfully shut down major online networks monetizing non-consensual deepfake pornography of prominent celebrities.

stories.headline: Elon Musk Drops Apple from Antitrust Lawsuit, Keeps Fighting OpenAI
stories.blurb: Musk's ongoing legal challenge against OpenAI's commercial shift continues to escalate, even as Apple is dropped from the active complaint.
